# Full IM

Compose Conversation, Contacts, Groups, Search, Media, Calls, and Settings while keeping business side effects in the host.

## Preset

### Vue

~~~vue
const minimalFeatures = { enabled: ["conversations", "search", "media"] };
const fullFeatures = { enabled: ["conversations", "contacts", "groups", "calls", "search", "media", "savedMessages", "settings"] };
~~~

### Flutter

~~~dart
const minimalFeatures = FlareFeatureSet({'conversations', 'search', 'media'});
const fullFeatures = FlareFeatureSet({'conversations', 'contacts', 'groups', 'calls', 'search', 'media', 'savedMessages', 'settings'});
~~~

### Android Compose

~~~kotlin
val minimalFeatures = FlareApplicationFeatures(contacts = false, groups = false, calls = false, savedMessages = false, settings = false)
val fullFeatures = FlareApplicationFeatures(calls = true)
~~~

### SwiftUI

~~~swift
var minimalFeatures = FlareApplicationFeatures()
minimalFeatures.contacts = false; minimalFeatures.groups = false; minimalFeatures.calls = false
var fullFeatures = FlareApplicationFeatures()
fullFeatures.calls = true
~~~

## Composition

IMAppKit + AdaptiveNavigation + public Workspaces. Message renderer registry and action extensions carry product differences.

## States

Cover loading, empty, error, offline, permission, retry, large text, and responsive pane transitions globally.
